values.note: County camping rates: Electric/Water/Sewer $30 a night; Reservable Sites $40. Scott County resident $1 off; senior (62+) $1 off; 7 consecutive nights for the price of 6. The rates page does not name the campground for each type; this campground's own page gives electric, water and sewer.
Water at the sites only mid-April to mid-October, weather dependent; always available at the dump station.

season.source: https://www.scottcountyiowa.gov/conservation/scott-county-park/campgrounds/bald-eagle-campground ('open year round during season park hours. Due to weather conditions, water is available to the camp sites from mid April to mid October (weather dependent). Water is always available at the dump station.'), read 2026-11-02

values.note: Only some sites are reservable, May to September, on Scott County's own WebTrac; the rest register first come.

booking.source: https://www.scottcountyiowa.gov/conservation/scott-county-park/campgrounds/bald-eagle-campground ('Limited sites are reservable May - Sep'; link 'Reservations - limited sites from May - Sep'), read 2026-11-02

facilities.source: https://www.scottcountyiowa.gov/conservation/scott-county-park/campgrounds/bald-eagle-campground (Dump Station, Restrooms, Showers, Water; 'Water is always available at the dump station'), read 2026-11-02

values.note: Page: 'accommodates large Recreational Vehicles'. Select sites are fully accessible. No count or length posted.

note: Scott County Conservation, Scott County Park near Eldridge (18850 270th St), one of the park's five campgrounds. Open grassy loop with no water adjacent; Pride Lake is across the park road to the east. --Claude
summary: Confirmed e/w/s hookups, year-round, showers, dump, some sites reservable May-Sep. Added $30 base, $40 reservable (county rates page, resident and senior $1 off). Booking is on the county's WebTrac, not mycountyparks. Amperage (50) not on the operator's page, left; site count not posted. Pin within ~110 m of the loop.
flags: Booking: the note said mycountyparks.com, but Scott County's mycountyparks page lists only cabins and shelters; the campground page's 'Reservations' link is the county's own WebTrac (https://iascottctyweb.myvscloud.com/webtrac/web/search.html?display=Graphical&module=RN&type=Campsites). WebTrac answered 403 to plain HTTP, so per-site lists, lengths and amperage stayed unread (not retried).
No water lead: imagery shows the loop in an open clearing, with Pride Lake about 200+ m east across a park road; 'not waterfront' stands. Old note's 'wooded' dropped.
